_notes: Lighting presets for a hole ('look' in the hole file). elev/azim = sun height and compass direction in degrees (azim 0 = toward the far end of a hole, -Z). zenith/mid/horizon = sky gradient. fog* = distance haze. lit = fraction of windows with lights on. Numbers come from look_test/look_test.gd. 'menu' = the same low sun as golden_hour with a bluer sky, used to pre-render the main menu background (tools/render_menu_background.gd).
